prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-02
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): d8813c0a5d66b9cd
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Fetch TB reports TRAP: no progress max_addr=0x00000000 vs expected sequential NOP fetch progress beyond 0x0. mem_done at picorv32.v:376-377 is stuck-high because `resetn && (...) || (!mem_la_firstword || ...)` is true whenever !mem_la_firstword, so it asserts without mem_xfer/mem_state. Root cause is `||` instead of `&&` gating the compressed-firstword completion term, letting fetch retire without data and never advance PC.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash d8813c0a5d66b9cd in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
